# Nisc Cloud

> Everything your business needs to operate and grow online.

Nisc Cloud brings domains, cloud hosting, business email, websites, software, marketing and AI-powered workflows together in one account. For businesses, agencies and developers. Based in Nairobi, Kenya.

## Build. Run. Grow.

1. **Build** Brand identity, website design and development, ecommerce stores and custom software.
2. **Run** Domains (.ke, .co.ke, .com and more), web hosting, WordPress hosting, business email, VPS, VDS, dedicated servers, SSL certificates and website security. Hosting has a 99.9% uptime target.
3. **Grow** SEO / AEO / GEO, Google, Meta and TikTok advertising, social media management and email marketing.
4. **Zepo AI** Support for customer conversations, follow-ups and repetitive workflows in the services where it is available.

## Accreditation

- KeNIC-accredited registrar for .ke domains
- Licensed by the Communications Authority of Kenya
- Registered data controller with the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner (Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019)

## Why Work With Us

- Clients range from small and medium businesses to corporate organisations with more than 2,500 employees
- A dedicated account manager for managed services
- One account (nPanel) for services, invoices, renewals and support
- Clear plans; prices shown exclude 16% VAT
- 24/7 support by ticket, email and chat
- Pay with M-Pesa or card
- Free strategy call before you commit to marketing work

## Common Questions

- **Is website migration free?** Yes, within the scope agreed before the move. Extra work is quoted first and only charged once the client approves it.
- **What content is not allowed?** Illegal content, malware, spam, pornography, scams such as Ponzi or get-rich-quick schemes, and sites impersonating genuine businesses. Accounts that break these rules can be suspended without refund (see the Terms of Service).
- **Can I buy without talking to sales?** Yes. Domains, hosting, business email, servers and SSL certificates can be bought online with prices shown before checkout. Websites, software, marketing and larger infrastructure projects start with a conversation.
- **Who is Nisc Cloud for?** Businesses that want their digital services in one place, developers who need hosting and server control, and agencies that manage services for several clients.
- **Do you work with businesses outside Kenya?** Yes. The team is based in Nairobi and works digitally; support requests can be raised through nPanel, email or WhatsApp.
- **How long does a website take?** Essential websites (up to 5 pages) take about 10 days, Professional sites about 14 days and Enterprise projects about 21 days, provided content and feedback arrive promptly.
- **Is there a long contract?** Monthly services are month to month with 30 days notice to cancel. One-off projects are paid by milestone.

## Pricing

Current prices, billing cycles and renewal prices are on https://nisccloud.com/pricing and on each product page. Domain prices appear after you search. Corporate and enterprise requirements are quoted.
